### Security Checklist
<!-- Required for any PR touching database, SQL, AI, or auth -->

- [ ] AI-generated SQL is validated before execution
- [ ] No destructive SQL operations (INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/DROP/ALTER) are possible
- [ ] Edited SQL is re-validated before execution
- [ ] No API keys or secrets are hardcoded or logged
- [ ] No raw Node.js APIs exposed to the renderer
- [ ] Database contents are not sent to AI unnecessarily

- [ ] Security tests pass (`pnpm test:security`)
- [ ] TypeScript check passes (`pnpm type-check`)
- [ ] Linting passes (`pnpm lint`)
- [ ] App starts successfully (`pnpm dev:next`)
